# What must a mosquito spray visit and season program cost?

> Free mosquito control pricing calculator for barrier spray operators: type your product, labour, drive time and re-treat rate to see the minimum price per visit and per prepaid season, customer lifetime value and customers needed to break even. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
